pencil noun

also school things, lead pencil

modern

Traupman 30
Traupman 338

graphium, graphiī n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

Classically a stylus (Ov.).

Other words

  • plumbum

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. pen: pencil

    Literally lead.

  • graphis, graphidis f. — a drawing pencil

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Ser. ap. Diom. p. 516 P.: graphidem date (Lewis & Short); Andresian p. 12 · Declension on Wiktionary

    A drawing pencil in a fragment quoted by Diomedes; in Vitruvius and Pliny it is drawing itself (Lewis & Short). Rarer than Traupman’s graphium, classically a stylus.

Examples

  • Graphium cape et nōmen tuum scrībe.

    Take a pencil and write your name.composed

  • stilus plumbātus

    a lead pencilTraupman 338

See also crayon, eraser, exercise book.
